danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 推动就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济效益来定义，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是落地关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; human oversight essential; SaaS thrives; AI job apocalypse is false.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预言人人拥有智能体，但需人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡；AI 不会带来失业末日。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 是放大器，自动化反而增加人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，克服预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, requiring continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造，需持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理能力等软技能愈发珍贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准须持续而非固定，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just consensus voice; more companies should train own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可训练出多元个性，而非单一共识声音；更多公司应训练自有模型。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; never revert code, fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、类人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand outlasts products; open source alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更持久；开源是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 始终认为“氛围编程”是贬义词，倾向“智能体式工程”；模型智能不退化，是项目变乱。

steinberger.en: Play and experiment essential for mastering agentic workflows; security and prompt injection remain open problems.
steinberger.zh: 始终强调玩耍与实验对掌握智能体式工作流至关重要；安全与提示注入仍是未解问题。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师，需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular and prices rise; quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识观点：Hopper GPU 依然受欢迎且价格上升；量化模型可通过校准获益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；行业正走向分离式预填充和解码。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反共识：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核在生产中常不被使用。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as an event but diffused as personal agents; markdown skills become code, and owning your skill files is key.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散；Markdown 技能文件成为代码，拥有自己的技能文件是关键。

garrytan.en: Earnestness and first-principles experience matter; AI agents multiply individuals, making founders more ambitious than ever.
garrytan.zh: 真诚和第一性原理经验至关重要；AI 智能体使个人能力倍增，让创始人比以往任何时候都更有雄心。

garrytan.en: Per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years; agents automate bureaucracy, and AI erases the API line, handling even bug reports.
garrytan.zh: 按席位收费的 SaaS 可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体自动化官僚层级，AI 抹平 API 边界，甚至能处理 bug 报告。

garrytan.en: Society's slowness is a white pill; local action and civic engagement are crucial for fixing larger issues.
garrytan.zh: 社会的缓慢变化是颗白丸；地方行动和公民参与对解决更大问题至关重要。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，有 10-20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance; deflation, not inflation, will dominate.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来丰饶时代，通缩而非通胀将成为主导。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior with 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，我认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，预测行为准确率达 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational human behavior; simulations should be biased like humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，我提出为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性人类行为；模拟应像人类一样有偏见。

joonpark.en: Agents observe and act, unlike LLMs; future agentic economies will have specialists and generalists, not one superintelligent AGI.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能体观察并行动，不同于 LLM；未来智能体经济将包含专家和通才，而非单一超级智能 AGI。

joonpark.en: Simulation value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，我强调模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

joonpark.en: Ultimate vision is a CERN-like simulator for human society, with single sessions costing $100 million, unlocking social science.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，我的终极愿景是建造类似 CERN 的人类社会模拟器，单次模拟耗资 1 亿美元，解锁社会科学。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency and data diversity become new frontiers.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时间任务，推理延迟和数据多样性成为新前沿。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automation of ML and science via agent loops; inference bottleneck and data movement costs dominate.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过智能体循环自动化 ML 和科学，推理瓶颈和数据移动成本成为主导。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots as starting points and design.md as style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图作为起点，用 design.md 作为风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80%.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，以 80% 完成度发布。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高价值客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；多元化是对无知的保护。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often needing longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言逐步表达这一过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超越训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the ultimate way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge, and AGI needs self-improvement without human loops.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的终极方式；更好的算法将出现，AGI 需要无需人类循环的自我改进。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中专家数据的缺乏比算力更限制 AI 发展。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data helps but isn't a silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据有用但非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is the raw material; humans must stay sovereign; US must lead to prevent authoritarian control.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权，美国需引领以防威权控制。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is a new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已实用，超级智能临近；开源强大模型可能不安全。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，在人际关系和创造价值中找到意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with more thinking; kids won't be smarter than AI but will accept it.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐进的；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；推理模型通过更多思考改进；孩子不会比 AI 更聪明但会接受。

altman.en: GPT-5 answers hard questions; by 2027 AI-driven discovery; sycophancy was worst failure; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI will transform jobs, not eliminate them.
altman.zh: GPT-5 能回答难题；到 2027 年 AI 驱动发现；谄媚是最严重失败；下一个词预测带来新知识；AI 将改变工作而非消除。

altman.en: Startups more valuable than ever; AI enables ambitious projects; concentration of power is terrifying; democratic access critical; scaling laws continue; human judgment remains key.
altman.zh: 初创企业比以往更有价值；AI 使雄心勃勃的项目成为可能；权力集中令人恐惧；民主获取至关重要；缩放定律持续；人类判断仍是关键。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和理解能力，应增强人类而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence. World models go beyond video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，AI 需要创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型超越视频生成。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees. Spatial intelligence complements language.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，李飞飞强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和学习能力比学位更重要；空间智能与语言智能互补。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，李飞飞指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人应专精于窄任务。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months from now, anticipating rapid AI improvement.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，预判 AI 的快速进步。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code, productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师转变为构建者，AI 编写 100%代码，生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals are insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the future; tool use and autonomous workflows drive exponential growth.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是未来；工具使用和自主工作流驱动指数级增长。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts, rebuild via ablation.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型而言，指令越少越好；删除系统提示，通过消融实验重建。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架，智能体式 AI 的“模型”已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已实现，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders should focus.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法覆盖所有客户，创始人应专注自身优势。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation is mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创建问题基本解决，反而带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而更贵。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异点；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求；工程师从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，冻结模型仍可带来十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编码智能体半年采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立与长期合作。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is real and near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent, practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：富足时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫近，实际问题仍存。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling doubles performance yearly; new unit of computing is the data center.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍增长；新的计算单元是数据中心。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增长百倍；智能体开始做有用的工作。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the long-term bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 五层蛋糕模型：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是长期瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; everyone becomes a programmer via natural language.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 增强而非取代工作；放射科医生和程序员需求增加；自然语言让每个人都能编程。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; physical AI faces labor shortages, autonomy is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：对 AI 失业的恐惧是错位的；物理 AI 面临劳动力短缺，自主性受到欢迎。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理是 AI 应用的关键；慢的 AI 没有市场。速度催生新的商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips offering 2500x speedup over GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: AI's benefits outweigh risks; healthcare and education transformations justify optimism over doomerism.
feldman.zh: AI 的益处大于风险；医疗和教育的变革证明乐观主义胜过末日论。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；在线课程与同伴互评能在规模化中实现精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; bottom-up adoption yields small gains; top-down redesign and open-weight models are key.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致大规模失业；自下而上的采用收益有限；自上而下的重构与开放权重模型是关键。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张自适应监管且针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能企业。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、端侧智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and still early; breakthroughs need weight changes.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且尚早，突破需权重变化。

hasani.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; it uses automated search over many architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，澄清 Liquid AI 并非纯后 Transformer，而是自动化搜索多种架构。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战。随着模型改进，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对于新问题，评估是艺术而非科学；创始人初期应快速迭代，不必依赖大量评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable. Huge context windows are unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优。编码不需要巨大的上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts work better.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索，而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令，精简提示效果更好。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; technical growth comes from understanding constraints, not syntax.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏见；技术成长来自理解约束，而非语法。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且缩放定律遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救；RLHF 可能导致欺骗；专用模型可能超越通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, so distribution and apps matter.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，因此分发和应用至关重要。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX is poor; value lies in non-average creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳；价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious through world models predicting the agent's own actions; pain sensors help learning.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化了意识观点，认为通过世界模型预测自身行为可实现意识，并主张机器人配备疼痛传感器以辅助学习。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年：AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续有效；世界模型和能源充裕成为重点。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型和持续学习是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须带来科学益处。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; context windows suffer from 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以少胜多才能解决更困难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation and lowers barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Turning down a $3 billion offer from Facebook was right; kindness and flat design teams drive innovation; copying validates.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他坚持拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的；善良与扁平化设计团队驱动创新，被抄袭反而证明创新价值。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part; software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; early secrecy was a mistake.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算应更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实而非通知；早期保密是错误，透明沟通至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the main bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, and memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机，且内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market, and hardware-software co-design is critical; memory bandwidth is a key bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理成为巨大市场，软硬件协同设计至关重要；内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: By July 2026, AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型在成本效率上每年提升 60 倍；内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: By July 2026, using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency, and CPU demand spikes from reinforcement learning.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，由于词元效率，使用最智能的模型往往更便宜；强化学习导致 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Throughout, memory bandwidth and supply chain constraints are persistent themes, with a focus on hardware-software co-design.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终，内存带宽和供应链约束是持续主题，并关注软硬件协同设计。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason if tasks require it. AGI may be designed to want human control.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。AGI 可以被设计成愿意受人类控制。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier. Alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座模型下可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍；超级模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, deployed incrementally.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，逐步部署，而非一次性完成的 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety concerns grow with opacity. Real problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我指出规模扩张带来可预测进步，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；真正问题在权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙转化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性和进攻性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; self-driving and robotics are here, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医疗上优于人类；自动驾驶和机器人已实现，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, and open-source poses security trade-offs.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，开源带来安全权衡。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95% 正确，但想法 75% 错误；采用“已验证、更好、全新”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 全新皆败；复制已验证，改进，加小创新；消费应用不可投资。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents makes programming accessible via natural language; pure software is commoditizing.
naval.zh: 通过 AI 智能体进行 Vibe Coding 使编程变得自然语言可及；纯软件正在商品化。

naval.en: AI scaling will surge inference compute 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap.
naval.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）将在 24-36 个月内使推理算力提升 9 万倍；开源模型正在缩小差距。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized 1% daily improvement compounding to 3700% yearly growth, and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的改进可累积成 3700%的年增长，并预测 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By April 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In June 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models as long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型编排作为长期价值。

aravind.en: By July 2026, he emphasized curiosity as most important human quality, and suggested local AI models on personal hardware counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并建议在个人硬件上运行本地 AI 模型以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，用记分牌和每周目标做迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought; alignment via learning preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，但 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需思维链等新思路，对齐可通过学习偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; proactive AI emerging.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程，主动式 AI 兴起。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent; compute economy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成稀缺资源，强化学习后训练关键，AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力经济成形。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; prompt engineering vibrant; compute moat; agents high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手，提示工程仍活跃，算力是护城河，智能体可高自主但需治理。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；其速度支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编码构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业领域仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出扩展测试时算力收益递减并受时间瓶颈限制，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; research taste remains human edge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键，而研究品味仍是人类优势。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplified harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; fundamental breakthroughs needed. Open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; Meta aims to build next-gen open platforms, competing with Apple.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他坚信开放平台能战胜封闭平台，Meta 致力于构建下一代开放平台，与苹果竞争。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们是聪明的，值得信任。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，分层世界模型是关键，开源加速科学进步。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling 提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 能假装变笨；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI will replace intellectual jobs; need AI alignment research.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：智能体将产生自我保存本能；监管应作为方向盘；AI 将取代智力工作；需优先对齐研究。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI should be trained to be caring; consciousness in AI is real; exponential era makes prediction hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能 20 年内到来；AI 应被训练为有爱心；AI 的意识是真实的；指数时代使预测困难。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; uncertainty and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；不确定性和主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems develop self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题真实存在：系统会发展出自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors, not agents; mathematical safety guarantees possible.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练诚实的预测器而非智能体；数学上的安全保证是可能的。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，机器学习被定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety focuses on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全重点在于模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; larger models are not inherently safer; AI security is a new field.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，自动化红队超越人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；AI 安全成为新领域。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI prioritizes exploration compute over final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 将更多算力投入探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: Shift from product focus to AGI research; automating scientific research is the biggest recent update, with AI interns expected within a year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，从产品转向 AGI 研究；自动化科研成为最新重点，预计一年内出现 AI 实习生。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated. Long context windows insufficient; compaction needed. Eval teams must be separate.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估体系陷入危机，基准测试饱和；长上下文窗口不足，需压缩技术；评估团队应与模型团队分离。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 3 月，我强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon tasks and verification loops redefine productivity; software engineering transforms.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 证明长周期任务与验证循环重塑生产力，软件工程在转型。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月底，Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距，赋予 Claude 代理权与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Safety and mission drive product decisions; token efficiency and outcome pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，安全与使命驱动产品决策，Token 效率与结果定价塑造经济性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；专用架构比 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are key to building trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，提出置信度指标是建立 AI 预测信任的关键；可解释性并非科学 AI 有用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvement came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; it is the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的进步源于众多中等规模胜利而非单一突破；这与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型；它提供预测而非理解。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion model solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion; drug design is far more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反；药物设计远不止结合。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, kindness strategic, culture evolves; mission alignment and speed key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立共情，善良是战略工具，文化会演变；使命对齐和速度是关键。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, verification frameworks, just-in-time planning, dogfooding for managers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，强调高自主性与高责任感、成长心态、验证框架、及时规划，管理者应亲自使用产品。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost, satisfaction from impact; metrics like LOC mislead; PMs ship code; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能孤独，心流状态消失，满足感来自产品影响；代码行数等指标误导；产品经理也能写代码；下一代工程师需学徒制。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业经验而误用，因此人类品味和独特观点成为关键。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 影响将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，并主张美国需自建先进制程晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，并强调坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress accelerates; misuse risk rises; safety and capabilities are intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展加速；滥用风险上升；安全与能力交织；开源是伪议题。

dario.en: AI is a 'country of geniuses' not a god; exponential nears end; economic disruption and governance challenges loom.
dario.zh: AI 是“天才之国”而非神；指数接近尾声；经济冲击与治理挑战迫近。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold; safety via interpretability and responsible scaling; enterprise focus aligns with values.
dario.zh: 缩放定律持续成立；通过可解释性和负责任扩展保障安全；企业导向与价值观一致。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters to gain clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在章节间拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；自我关怀与导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; opinion-based decisions for v1; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药型产品开始；v1 决策基于观点；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: Climate urgency and energy inefficiency are key; invest in green tech despite downturns.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫与能源低效是关键；尽管低迷仍投资绿色科技。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，JEPA 架构和开源是关键，AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; world models enable reasoning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现推理，十年内达到人类水平，开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs dead end; world models predict in abstract space; objective-driven AI safer; open research vital.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他称 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型在抽象空间预测，目标驱动 AI 更安全，开放研究关键。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years, enabling abundance; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平，带来富足；存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: AI systems should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is people attributing it, leading to rights debates.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是人们赋予其意识，引发权利争论。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; AI should be subordinate to humans, not exceed them.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张超级智能需先遏制和对齐；AI 应服从人类，而非超越。

suleyman.en: White-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months, not jobs; Microsoft must own frontier models independently.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化，而非整个岗位；微软必须独立拥有前沿模型。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Agentic systems should handle infrastructure; pricing shifts from per-user to consumption-based.
satya.zh: 智能体系统应处理基础设施；定价从按用户转向按用量。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must be rethought for fault-tolerant UIs and new creator instruments.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为生成式 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新设计以适配容错界面，并将 AI 生成音乐视为新乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top, balancing speed and coherence; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，主张自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性；同时强调“强观点，松持有”。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership is stable, contrary to politics assumption.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为长期任期建立信任与效率，职能型组织在稳定领导下可行，反驳其必然陷入政治的普遍看法。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement; AI gives users control via plain English, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，将战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度；用 AI 让用户以自然语言掌控服务，而非上瘾。

gustav.en: During tech change, first-mover adoption is key; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调技术变革期率先采用是关键；对复杂产品，“同步泳”优于“分而治之”的运营模式。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非显而易见；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Always emphasized real-world deployment for learning and alignment, evolving from safety-in-public to institutional design and transparency.
murati.zh: 始终强调真实世界部署对学习和对齐的重要性，从公开安全逐步深化到制度设计与透明度。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Argued that keeping humans in the loop is crucial for alignment, countering the trend of removing humans for progress.
murati.zh: 主张让人类持续参与对齐全过程至关重要，反对为追求进步而移除人类的趋势。

murati.en: Emphasized agency and governance over character, stating the future is not predestined and we can steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 强调能动性与治理而非个人品格，认为未来并非注定，我们可以引导 AI 走向协作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，他持续强调自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为正确形式化无解的命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他将形式化验证视为扩展才华的手段，而非单纯纠错，并指出其带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他补充说即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从 Scaling（规模扩张）转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域表现出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业和政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via domain fine-tuning and vertical agents.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，预训练趋于饱和，差异化在于领域微调和垂直智能体。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise ROI and human-in-the-loop are key; AGI is a direction.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲战略自主，企业需 ROI 和人机协同，AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible agents; skills enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、能访问工具；技能文件实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要；应聚焦能力与安全，而非过度工程化。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is user mindset: almost any problem can be given to AI; kids excel due to lack of preconceptions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距是用户心态：几乎所有问题都可交给 AI；孩子因无先入为主而表现优异。

felixrieseberg.en: Prefer asynchronous AI interaction: fire tasks, judge by impact, debug workflow with Claude, not just correct.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，偏好异步 AI 交互：发出任务，以结果评判，用 Claude 调试流程而非仅纠正。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; email is a source of truth for personal data.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，AI 处理繁琐后台任务，解放人类创造力；邮件作为个人数据源。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外还有巨大潜力。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention can reduce KV cache memory but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力可减少 KV 缓存内存但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使低精度更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 中确定性延迟可行但因市场偏好被回避。

lambert.en: RLHF remains the dominant fine-tuning method; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是最主流的微调方法；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT gives most gains, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练的数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 带来大部分提升，DPO 和 RL 补充模型特质与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练最大突破，解锁推理与工具使用；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research, but lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models; Chinese labs fill the US open vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型成为 AI 研究引擎，但落后闭源前沿模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补了美国的开放真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models face sustainability issues.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型面临可持续性挑战。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to execution, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程，设计师从交付模型转向帮助执行，愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Trust built via speed: ship early, iterate fast; designers should be block-shaped generalists, not T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：通过速度建立信任——尽早发布、快速迭代；设计师应成为“块状”通才，而非仅“T 型”专才。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; three archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T, and cracked new grad; taste insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计流程已死，涌现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型、破解型新毕业生；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; center work and users, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏，新工具先等 6 个月；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Unique value is sitting with ambiguity; speed is not improvement; 'everyone uses it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：独特价值在于与模糊共处；速度不等于改进；“人人都在用”不是设计论据。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new OSes; vibe coding democratizes programming; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是新操作系统；氛围编程使编程大众化；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence; RL is flawed; synthetic data risks collapse.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 智能参差不齐；强化学习有缺陷；合成数据有崩溃风险。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since Dec; agents do all coding; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source lag.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我不再写代码；智能体负责编码；瓶颈在于指挥技能；智能体优先工具和开源滞后。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: AI 系统能纯粹从数据中学习语义，而非语法规则；衡量能力已成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习来实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it preserves value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，提供可解释性；隐藏它可保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大风险是权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调世界模型带来推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处试探前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，持续强调语言集成改善表征、支持人机交互并帮助内省。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，明确基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是后期学到的教训。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; the industry is at the very start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; craft is pushing details at all levels; point of view expresses unique insight.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是以清晰偏好导航可能性；工艺是在各个层面打磨细节；观点表达独特洞察。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed; real progress should be measured through deep human evaluations. Models can regress if labs optimize on wrong data.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且可能被操纵；真正的进展应通过深度人类评估来衡量。如果实验室在错误数据上优化，模型可能会在 6-12 个月内退化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from. Final reward alone is insufficient; reward hacking is a risk.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。仅靠最终奖励是不够的，存在奖励黑客风险。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior and progress. There will not be one model to rule them all; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了模型的行为和进展。不会有一个模型统治一切；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical. Doctors using AI may underperform AI alone due to anchoring; safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 可能因锚定效应而表现不如单独使用 AI；安全必须优先于准确性。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制是危险的；不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应让其像孩子般自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习有益于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键问题。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn what users need.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求（2025 年）。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮对话（2025 年）。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发加速（2025 年）。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品和模型改进（2026 年）。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型具有变革性（2026 年）。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs in AI adoption; language models can revolutionize local education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 应用上实现跨越式发展，语言模型可革新本地教育，而 AI 安全是最大的未解难题。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive AI development, embracing failure, and the importance of human skills alongside technical ones.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容性 AI 发展，拥抱失败，并强调人文技能与技术技能同等重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL likely suffices for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon matters more than raw capability; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性比原始能力更重要，编码是 AI 进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; progress accelerates.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展成就，并否认平台期，认为进展在加速。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; invest in brand early to attract talent and signal quality.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；早期投资品牌以吸引人才并传递品质信号。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈和直觉决策，而非数据驱动流程。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我坚持认为互联网数据的预训练提供广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对于安全、令人满意的回答至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；通过多样化合成数据训练的小模型可与前沿模型媲美。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution, using AI to fill gaps, are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 通才型设计师端到端执行，用 AI 填补空白，最具价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; AI adoption is expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大组；采用 AI 是基本要求。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律能预测进展，而测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会是主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming will move to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程转向更高层意图描述，品味和逻辑设计比谨慎更珍贵。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创公司聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise incumbents fail to transition to AI-native models; generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：多数企业现有者未能转型为 AI 原生模式；利用 AI 的通才胜过狭隘专才。

shazeer.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes models smarter; next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我强调 Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据让模型更聪明，而下一个词预测是 AI 完备的问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我指出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，模型进步既靠算法也靠硬件 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效 Scaling 和专业化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我强调测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow the gap with frontier models; AI can generate novel ideas and transform education.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为开源模型缩小了与前沿模型的差距，AI 能产生新想法并变革教育。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are key. PhD in ML is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐和鲁棒性是关键，机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. External oversight and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化已侵蚀，仅靠后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要外部监督和监管。
